packageRules.description: eslint-plugin-unicorn is pinned to ^61.0.2 because later majors require eslint>=10.4, and this repo is intentionally on eslint@^9 — see docs/lint-plugins-report.md. Bumping either major requires re-verifying the whole eslint.config.mjs plugin set by hand, not an automated PR. Re-enable once that migration is deliberately done.
